description: Makita DTR181ZJ 18V Li-ion LXT Brushless Rebar Cutting Tool Supplied in a Makpac Case – Batteries and Charger Not Included - Distributed/Packaged by Makita. Product Details: Makita is the leading manufacturer of professional power tools on the market. The DTR181ZJ is a cordless Rebar Cutting Tool, powered by 18V Li-ion LXT slide type battery (not included) to supply energy to the powerful 18V brushless motor, to deliver up to a maximum power output of 340W. The DTR181ZJ has been designed to enable the tying of large diameter rebars, including D16 x D16 – (D13 x 2) x (D16 x 2) and is compatible with thick rebars (D22 x D25). The maximum tying capacity is 4 rebars D16 (#5) x 2 x D13 (#4) x 2. The DTR181ZJ can be operated with one hand to allow the other hand to adjust the position of rebar and is equipped with main switch with auto power off, trigger lock function, 6 stage adjustable tying strength; can be adjusted to suit the combination of rebars by operating the panel located above the battery, torque adjustment and two mode settings; single actuation and continuous actuation. Continuous actuation mode for continuous tying. The DTR181ZJ features automatic rebar tying; can be carried out automatically in a various range of applications including building concrete foundations and eXtreme Protection Technology (XPT) for use in outdoor applications or harsher weather conditions to protect from dust and dripping water. Easy tie wire replacement; simply open the reel cover. There are three types of tie wires available; approximate tie wire: annealed wire 0.8mm (21 Ga), galvanised wire 0.8mm (21 Ga), poly coated wire 0.9mm (20 Ga). The DTR181ZJ is capable of delivering up to 5,000 (D16 x 2, 2 pieces of rebars) tying times per charge with a fully charged BL1860B 18V 6.0 Ah battery (not included). The DTR181ZJ is not compatible with G-Series batteries. 1 year manufacturer warranty with a further 2 years when registered within 30 days of purchase. This guarantee does not apply where non-genuine or recommended parts or accessories are fitted to the tool. The use of non-genuine or compatible batteries and chargers with Makita tools will invalidate the Makita guarantee for our tools.
